messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: ur5e-manual, p. 126

The tool speed and force are limited at the tool flange and the center of the two user-defined tool positions. Copyright © 2009–2025 by Universal Robots A/S. All rights reserved. NOTICE You can switch back to Factory Presets for all robot limits to reset to their default settings. Wrist Clamping Torque Limit Description Wrist Clamping Torque Limit is a setting that enables or disables limitation of the maximum clamping torque for the wrist joints of the robot. The limitation is enabled by default. This safety function limits how much torque the wrist can apply when pushing. UR5e 129 User Manual
